Safety and Tolerability of Fb-PMT in Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Daily subcutaneous injection of fb-PMT in four escalating cohorts to determine maximum tolerated dose

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven intracranial glioblastoma, with first or second recurrence

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] fb-PMT (other names: NP-100, NP751): Daily dosing based on patient weight

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational multi-pathway signalling inhibitor fb-PMT (NP-100, NP751), subcutaneous
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: fb-PMT affects a large group of cancer cell signaling pathways and thus may be effective in heterogeneous, treatment-resistant tumors such as Glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Single-arm dose escalation in recurrent glioblastoma. No PK or pharmacodynamic outcomes registered. Development code first written as 'Fb-PMT' in the title; moiety recorded in lower case.
